earlierRuns.explanation: The first preliminary D3D10 run timed out on the exact blue pixel after authentication and loading checks passed; that run did not capture the observed color. Cause remains unproven. Diagnostics were added without changing the assertion; two subsequent fresh D3D10 x64 cases passed exact red/blue and survivor pixel checks.

The old x64-only strict controller rejected the SDK's expected x64 architecture-mismatch diagnostic 706 followed by x86 success. It stopped before releasing the demo startup barrier. The controller now validates both sections and delegates the x86 result to the existing strict parser; the actual captured output and both fresh x86 graphics cases pass. No SDK code or native payload changed for this correction.
